content.comment_body: Hello, I have a question about connecting a [product_name] device to a Beijer screen, since they use different communication protocols. I'm considering using a protocol converter, but I'm unsure which protocol the [product_name] uses. Any advice would be appreciated.
The [product_name] with [article_no] communicates over Ethernet TCP/IP using the S7 protocol. However, the S7 protocol details have not been publicly released by [company_name].
Is S7 protocol the same as S7 communication (ISO/TCP)?
I'm not completely sure, but it's possible. Remotely, you can access the data in the VM area as DB1. Please specify which Beijer Panel model you have.
I am using a Beijer X2 Pro 10-inch panel.
Many Beijer panels can interface directly with [company_name] devices. The driver list on the X2 includes - S7 ISO over TCP/IP, which should work with [product_name] versions like 7 or 8.

Here are communication drivers for [company_name] in the Beijer X2 Pro 10 driver list. The highlighted driver enables direct communication with [product_name] models with [article_no]. If you need data exchange in the VM area, be aware the panel might not recognize VM variables. In that case, the panel can read or write data to the VM area as DB1.

analysis.insight_summary: Forum contributors are discussing how to connect a [product_name] device to a Beijer X2 Pro HMI panel, facing difficulties due to unclear protocol compatibility. Users note the lack of accessible documentation for the protocol used by [company_name], making integration challenging. Participants also highlight variable mapping issues (VM area versus DB1) between the devices, which adds complexity to the communication setup.
analysis.user_expectations: Users hope for clear, publicly accessible documentation about the communication protocols used by the [product_name] device so they can easily connect to third-party HMIs. They also expect a seamless setup without requiring extra converters.
